Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 1822 of 2024
Petitioner :- Vikash Anand And Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

Counsel for Petitioner :- Satendra Nath Rai
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Amarjeet Singh,Umesh Singh
Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Heard.

By means of this petition, the petitioners have sought quashing of F.I.R. dated 29.12.2023 bearing case Crime No. 0532/2023 for the offence under Sections 498A, 506, 406 I.P.C. registered at Police Station Krishna Nagar, District- Lucknow South (Commissionerate Lucknow).

After arguing the matter at length, learned counsel for the petitioners confines his prayer to protection prescribed under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said protection is statutorily available in cases where the sentence regarding an offence is of seven or less than seven years, therefore, the police is obliged to extend the benefit of the said provision wherever attracted and no specific direction is required.

If during investigation any other Section is added, then the law will take its own course, meaning thereby, if the provisions contained in Section 41 or 41-A are not attracted to the said offence/section, then it shall be open for the police to proceed accordingly.

In the event any new section is added carrying a sentence of more than seven years, it shall be open for the petitioner to approach this Court or to seek such other remedies as may be prescribed under law.

Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
[Rajeev Singh, J.]

[ Rajan Roy, J.] Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Santosh/-
